claims.text: Hib: asplenia → 1 dose if ⍉prior Hib; elective splenectomy → 1 dose, preferably ≥ 14 days b4.
claims.quote: Anatomical or functional asplenia (including sickle cell disease): 1 dose if previously did not receive Hib vaccine. Elective splenectomy: 1 dose preferably at least 14 days before splenectomy
claims.locator: Haemophilus influenzae type b vaccination: special situations

claims.text: MenACWY: asplenia → 2-dose primary series ≥ 8 wks apart; booster Q5yr if risk remains.
claims.quote: Special situations for MenACWY Anatomical or functional asplenia (including sickle cell disease), HIV infection, persistent complement component deficiency, complement inhibitor (e.g., eculizumab, ravulizumab) use: 2–dose primary series Menveo or MenQuadfi at least 8 weeks apart; 1 booster dose 5 years after primary series and every 5 years if risk remains
Special situations for MenB Anatomical or functional asplenia (including sickle cell disease)

claims.text: Pneumococcal: congenital or acquired asplenia = a listed RF.
claims.quote: Underlying medical conditions or other risk factors include alcoholism, chronic heart/liver/lung disease, chronic renal failure, cigarette smoking, cochlear implant, congenital or acquired asplenia
